Gold Rate & Market Guide

Gold Rate Today Sargodha – Complete Guide to Gold Prices

Learn how the gold rate today in Sargodha is understood, how 24K, 22K, 21K and 18K gold prices differ, and how per-tola, per-gram and jewellery prices are calculated.

📍 Sargodha, Pakistan 📅 Updated September 2026 SM Gold Sargodha

If you are searching for gold rate today Sargodha, you are probably looking for the latest reference price before buying jewellery, selling old gold, planning a wedding purchase or comparing jewellery shops in the city.

Gold prices are not fixed permanently. They can change as international gold markets move, currency exchange rates change and local market conditions develop. This is why searches such as gold rate today in Sargodha, gold rate in Sargodha today and today gold rate Sargodha are closely connected.

Important: Online gold-rate figures should be treated as market references. The final buying or selling price can differ according to timing, purity, weight, workmanship and other applicable charges.

What Is the Gold Rate Today in Sargodha?

The gold rate in Sargodha represents the market value used as a reference for gold of a particular purity and weight. In Pakistan, buyers commonly see gold prices quoted per tola, while jewellery may also be discussed by gram or 10 grams.

When checking the Sargodha gold rate today, always check the date and time of the displayed figure. A price shown earlier may not represent the latest market position.

24K, 22K, 21K and 18K Gold Rates

One of the most important things to understand when comparing the gold price Sargodha market is purity. Gold jewellery can be made in different karats, and each karat contains a different proportion of pure gold.

Purity Approx. Gold Content Common Use
24K Approximately 99.9% High-purity gold and bullion reference
22K Approximately 91.6% Traditional jewellery
21K Approximately 87.5% Jewellery and traditional designs
18K Approximately 75% Everyday and design-focused jewellery

24K Gold Rate in Sargodha

24K gold is commonly used as the high-purity benchmark when discussing gold prices. Because it contains a very high proportion of gold, its underlying metal value is different from 22K, 21K and 18K jewellery.

Customers searching for the 24k gold rate Sargodha should check whether the quoted number is per gram, per 10 grams or per tola. Comparing different units without conversion can make two otherwise similar rates appear different.

22K Gold Rate in Sargodha

22K gold contains approximately 91.6% pure gold. It is widely associated with traditional jewellery and is an important purity when customers compare the 22k gold rate Sargodha market.

A jewellery quotation should clearly explain the purity, weight and applicable workmanship so the customer can understand what the quoted price represents.

21K Gold Rate in Sargodha

21K gold contains approximately 87.5% gold. It is another important jewellery purity used in Pakistan.

When checking the 21k gold rate Sargodha market, make sure the quotation refers to 21K and not another karat. The same weight can have a different metal value at different purities.

18K Gold Rate in Sargodha

18K gold contains approximately 75% pure gold. The additional alloy content can provide different physical characteristics and design possibilities.

Customers searching for the 18k gold rate Sargodha market should compare it with other 18K quotations rather than directly comparing it with a 24K benchmark.

Gold Price Per Tola in Sargodha

Pakistan's gold market commonly uses the traditional unit called a tola. One tola is approximately 11.664 grams.

Therefore, when you see a gold price per tola Sargodha, you can estimate the equivalent per-gram figure by dividing the per-tola value by approximately 11.664.

Example: If a reference price were Rs 100,000 per tola, the approximate per-gram value would be Rs 100,000 ÷ 11.664 = about Rs 8,573 per gram. This is a simple unit conversion, not a live market quote.

Gold Price Per Gram in Sargodha

The gold price per gram Sargodha search is especially useful when evaluating small jewellery pieces, rings, earrings or other items whose weight is easier to discuss in grams.

Remember that weight and purity are separate concepts. A one-gram 24K item and a one-gram 18K item do not contain the same quantity of pure gold.

Gold Price for 10 Grams

Some customers prefer to compare the gold price 10 gram Sargodha rather than per gram or per tola.

If you already know the price per gram for the same purity, multiply it by ten to estimate the value for ten grams. Always ensure that the underlying rate is for the same karat and same market timing.

Why Does the Gold Rate Change?

The gold rate in Sargodha today can be influenced by several market factors.

  • International gold prices.
  • USD to PKR exchange-rate movements.
  • Local supply and demand.
  • Market trading conditions.
  • Timing of the quotation.
  • Differences between wholesale and retail pricing.

Why Is Jewellery More Expensive Than the Gold Rate?

One of the most common misunderstandings is assuming that the displayed gold rate is automatically the final price of a jewellery item.

A finished piece can include the value of the gold plus workmanship, design complexity, stone work, wastage policies and other applicable charges.

Net Gold Weight Matters

Jewellery can include stones, clasps or other non-gold components. Ask the jeweller about the item's net gold weight when discussing the metal value.

Making Charges Matter

Two jewellery pieces with similar gold weight can have different final prices if their designs require different levels of workmanship.

How to Check the Gold Rate Before Buying

  1. Check the date of the published rate.
  2. Confirm the karat or purity.
  3. Confirm whether the quote is per gram, per 10 grams or per tola.
  4. Ask for the exact jewellery weight.
  5. Ask for a breakdown of gold value and workmanship.
  6. Confirm the current local quotation before making the final payment.

Sarafa Bazar Sargodha Gold Rate

Customers looking for the sarafa bazar Sargodha gold rate are often comparing online market information with the quotation available from local jewellery shops.

This is useful, but online rates and individual jeweller quotations may not always match exactly. Differences can arise from update timing, market conditions, dealer spread, transaction type and jewellery-specific charges.

Gold Rate Today Sargodha: Buying vs Selling

The amount you receive when selling gold is not necessarily identical to the price you would pay when purchasing new jewellery.

Before selling old gold, ask how purity is assessed, how net weight is determined and what rate will be applied. Before buying jewellery, request a complete quotation showing the applicable components of the final price.

What is the gold price per tola in Sargodha?
